modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Cabin baggage over these limits for pieces, weight or size must be checked.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Each cabin piece up to 55 centimeters (22 inches) long, 40 centimeters (16 inches) wide and 20 centimeters (8 inches) high, stowed under the seat in front or in an overhead bin.

carryon_weight.value: Each cabin piece up to 8 kilograms (17 pounds).

pieces_by_cabin.value: First and Business Class: two pieces of cabin baggage. Economy Class: one piece.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: International and regional flights use a piece allowance that Xiamen Airlines publishes and updates on its baggage pages.

allowance_domestic.value: Domestic flights: 40 kilograms in First Class, 30 kilograms in Business Class, 20 kilograms in Economy Class. Children on child fares get the adult allowance; infants without a seat get none, but one stroller, bassinet or car seat travels free.

size_weight.value: Domestic flights: each piece up to 50 kilograms and 100 x 60 x 40 centimeters. International and regional flights: each piece up to 32 kilograms (45 kilograms to or from the United States) and 203cm in combined dimensions.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: These are Xiamen Airlines' own terms in its general conditions of carriage; a delay means more than 15 minutes late.

care.value: If a flight is delayed or cancelled at the departure airport for reasons attributable to Xiamen Airlines, it provides meals or accommodation under its regulations. If the cause is not attributable to it, it helps arrange meals or accommodation at the passenger's own expense.

refund.value: For an involuntary refund (flight cancelled, delayed, brought forward or rerouted), an unused ticket is refunded in full with refundable taxes and charges and no refund fee.

compensation.value: If a flight arrives late for reasons attributable to Xiamen Airlines: no more than RMB 200 per passenger for a delay of 4 hours (inclusive) to 8 hours, and no more than RMB 400 for 8 hours or more, paid in cash or free tickets as agreed with the passenger.

phone_home_market.notes: Listed in the footer of Xiamen Airlines' own baggage page.

fare_name.value: Standard / Economy Light: includes 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item; checked bag allowance depends on route and fare category

seat_selection_included.value: Free seat assignment provided during online check-in; advance seat selection prior to check-in is available for a fee

change_cancellation_policy.value: Ticket modifications and cancellations are subject to carrier fare rules, change fees, and applicable fare difference

modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose a seat by location and legroom, or accept a free seat assignment at check-in. Use your flight seat map because options vary with the aircraft.

seat_options.value: Standard seats, preferred location seats, and extra legroom seating options are available depending on aircraft and cabin class

reserved_or_random.value: Reserve a specific seat in advance for a fee or free depending on fare class, or receive a free seat assignment during online check-in

family_seating.value: Children traveling with an accompanying adult are seated together during advance seat reservation or at check-in
